title: PET RANCH ROUTINE
description: Base camps now include a small ranch where rescued pets can be fed, trained, renamed, assigned tiny jobs, and tucked into weatherproof beds before the next expedition.
consequence: The camp gets a reason to feel alive between runs. The daily checklist gets fur.

title: VACATION MODE MAP
description: The world map now highlights scenic routes, quiet fishing spots, and low-pressure story errands while hiding streak timers, urgent dailies, and limited-event alarms.
consequence: The journey gets room to breathe. Several blinking lights finally learn silence.

title: CAMP DECAY TIMER
description: Player camps now slowly lose durability while offline, with daily repair bonuses, emergency supply crates, and a cheerful reminder before anything important collapses.
consequence: Home starts needing attendance. The login button gets a maintenance schedule.

title: BEDTIME ENERGY AUDIT
description: Before logging out, players must review unspent energy, unfinished crops, idle companions, expiring buffs, and a suggested list of chores they are emotionally failing to complete.
consequence: The cozy routine gets a performance review. The return path gets covered in guilt paperwork.
